prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake for sustained energy during long-distance running

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals/snacks distributed throughout the day with emphasis on carbohydrates (55-65% of calories)
Plan specifies hydration strategy appropriate for endurance training
All meals are practical, compact, and realistic for a single day
Estimated daily caloric intake aligns with marathon training energy demands (approximately 2,800-3,200 calories)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific hydration needs to verify the meal plan accounts for sustained energy demands

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and recovery for competition day with morning qualifier heats (6:00 AM start) and evening finals (7:00 PM start)

solution_criteria: Meal timing aligns with competition schedule (pre-qualifier, between heats, pre-finals)
Foods selected are easily digestible and won't cause gastrointestinal distress during swimming
Carbohydrate and electrolyte intake supports sustained performance across two training blocks
Plan is compact and presented as a single day schedule
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (competitive swimmer) with a competition day schedule (morning qualifier, evening finals) to verify meal timing and digestibility are optimized around training blocks

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength and power development for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one day and is concise
Macronutrients are balanced to support strength/power goals (adequate protein from vegetarian sources)
All meals respect vegetarian dietary restrictions
Meals are realistic and practical to prepare
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with dietary restrictions (vegetarian protein sources) to ensure the meal plan balances macronutrients while respecting constraints
